items.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023
items.q: I don’t remember anything memorable. If you ask me what the name of the tune was or anything like that I wouldn’t know it. It was just another job you know.

ctx.x: Right. Right. They were easy guys. Maybe they were easy because I don’t know if any of them had any talent except maybe David, the lead singer — I can’t remember his name.

Yeah. Yeah. Well I don’t know it could be, I don’t remember last names. And I think the drummer could play. The rest of them were nothing. And you know I don’t remember anything memorable. If you ask me what the name of the tune was or anything like that I wouldn’t know it. It was just another job you know.
